title: Singles-only shadow team-strength baseline (pre-registered, forecasts only)
status: registered; forecasts recorded before first kickoff of the covered games
scope: Singles (single game, side or total-free) win-probability forecasts only. No stakes, no prices, no staking, no parlays. Shadow only: it is not a betting strategy and cannot be promoted by its own record.
kickoff_cutoff_note: First Week 11 kickoff: Thursday 19 Nov 2026, 8:15 PM ET (IND at HOU; official game centre https://www.nfl.com/games/colts-at-texans-2026-reg-11). Forecasts for Week 11 must be committed before this instant.

corpus.rule: every 2026 regular-season final in the file: weeks 1-10 (137 games). Sources: nfl.com week pages (source_url on each row). Week 10 games not yet played at registration (13 of 14) are excluded and enter only in a later, separately labelled record.
corpus.neutral_rule_training: a game is neutral when its official week-page note contains 'International'. Games with that note: 2026_REG_1_SF_LA, 2026_REG_3_BAL_DAL, 2026_REG_4_IND_WAS, 2026_REG_5_PHI_JAX, 2026_REG_6_HOU_JAX, 2026_REG_7_PIT_NO, 2026_REG_9_CIN_ATL.

fixtures.rule: the 13 Week 11 games; teams, dates and kickoffs cross-checked to data/model/snapshot.json (13/13, one code difference AZ vs ARI, flag CAP-05). Venues are transcribed from the official game centre 'Game Info' block.

model.type: ridge margin model (ratings + home-field term), standard library only
model.h: 1 unless the game is neutral (see corpus.neutral_rule_training and the forecast neutral rule: official game-centre location outside the United States => neutral)
model.penalty_on: club ratings only; the home-field term b is unpenalised
model.lambda_rule: fixed here before any Week 11 result exists; not tuned on the corpus; any change is shadow-v2
model.sigma: sqrt(SSE / n) of in-sample residuals on the corpus (a single number for all games)
model.win_probability: P(home win) = Phi(margin_home / sigma). Ties are not modelled.
fixture_context_recorded_not_used: rest days from official schedule dates
venue and neutral flag shown; neutral flag IS used in h
model.market_inputs: none. No betting line, price or third-party odds enters the model or the record.

control_random.rule: a seeded pick of home or away per game

control_favourite_record.rule: the side with the higher win percentage (ties count 0.5) over the corpus at registration; ties between the two sides go to the home side

scoring_rule_after_results.score: Brier score on P(home win) against the official final (1 home win, 0 otherwise)
scoring_rule_after_results.skill: 1 - Brier(model) / Brier(benchmark), for coin and for control_favourite_record
scoring_rule_after_results.uncertainty: game-cluster bootstrap by week (1000 resamples, seed 20261115), 95% interval

gates.G-SH1 record integrity: each game's forecast is committed before that game's kickoff. A record committed after kickoff is marked 'late' and is never scored as a forecast.
gates.G-SH2 reproducibility: python3 tools/shadow_forecast.py --check reproduces data/shadow/forecasts_week11_v1.json byte for byte
gates.G-SH3 input integrity: the corpus, fixture and code sha256 in the record equal the registration; the tool refuses to run otherwise
gates.G-SH4 benchmark-relative skill: after >= 40 graded games: lower 95% bound of skill vs coin AND vs control_favourite_record is above 0. Not yet evaluated (no graded games).

demotion_gate_pr07.applies_to: any strategy that moves from paper to stakes (none exists today; shadow-v1 cannot stake)
demote_to_paper_if_any: graded sample >= 40 games and the lower 95% bound of skill vs coin is below 0
a registered input (corpus, fixtures, code) is missing, edited or hash-mismatched for any scored game
two consecutive scoring weeks with negative point-estimate skill vs control_favourite_record
a forecast committed after kickoff is found in the scored set (G-SH1)
demotion_gate_pr07.status: proposed values, fixed at this commit before any result exists; a change needs a new commit that is logged on COORDINATION.md

toward_keeping_shadow_v1_as_benchmark: skill vs coin and vs control_favourite_record has a lower 95% bound above 0 after 40 graded games
predicted probabilities agree with outcomes within the bins (calibration slope between 0.8 and 1.2 proposed)
toward_retiring_shadow_v1: lower 95% bound of skill vs control_favourite_record below 0 after 40 graded games

sources.second_source_check: data/s9cb/games.csv (nflverse, third party): 137 of 137 scores agree; used only as a check
